answer: Burn-to-join bonding makes each newcomer burn a priced bond, sized by a spiral difficulty schedule, into a meadow escrow before any payout; release climbs a terrace of checkpoints until N verified tasks over T days. An attacker pays that bond plus gas per identity, and k fakes need k independent bonds and task histories; shared funding or overlapping submitters collapses the batch and forfeits all bonds. Admission caps at m per hour, so trust takes days.
